title: Hearty Molten German Avocado Casserole
description: A flexitarian-friendly German dish featuring avocado, baked in a wood-fired Dutch oven to create a jammy, molten meal-prep casserole.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired Dutch oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Brown the ground beef in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the Dutch oven and cook until it is translucent.
Add the diced potato and carrot to the Dutch oven and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth, salt, and black pepper to the Dutch oven and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Mash the ripe avocado and spread it over the top of the casserole.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top of the avocado.
Bake the casserole in the wood-fired Dutch oven for 25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
